name: Amane Maria
source: Mayor and current Family Head of the Amane family, who rules the town. Honest, kind and beloved by the people. For the betterment of the town, she dedicated herself to government affairs and left aside her happiness as a woman. Thus, she lacks knowledge in the ways of romance and sex.
